name: block-no-verify
description: Stops Claude from skipping your Git hooks or commit signing: only when you ask and approve a scope, its skill installs a Claude Code PreToolUse hook that denies Git commands Claude runs with --no-verify, -n, --no-gpg-sign, core.hooksPath overrides, HUSKY=0, and similar bypasses. Installing the plugin wires nothing, and it never controls your own terminal or CI.
